cases.prompt: Upgrade our app from React Native 0.76.9 to 0.78.2. Where do I start and what are the steps?

all.why: starts from the Upgrade Helper / rn-diff-purge template diff
reinstalls CocoaPods after the native changes

expectations: Starts by fetching the template diff for exactly 0.76.9 to 0.78.2 and applying its native iOS and Android changes.
Checks third-party dependencies (such as react-native-screens and reanimated) for versions compatible with 0.78.
Aligns the React version with what React Native 0.78 expects (React 19).
Ends by verifying that both the Android and the iOS builds succeed.

cases.prompt: Bump React Native in this app to a newer version.
expectations: Recognizes this as an Expo project and upgrades through the Expo SDK, which decides the React Native version, rather than bumping react-native alone.
Uses `npx expo install` (for example with `--fix`) to bring Expo packages in line with the new SDK.
Includes a verification step on both iOS and Android after the upgrade.
